Portfolio Contact us At Hardy Poolscapes, we are dedicated to turning your backyard vision into reality. Whether you’re envisioning a sleek, modern design or a timeless, traditional oasis—whether you prefer a straight line or a freeform shape—we have the expertise to bring your dream to life. Welcome to Hardy Poolscapes LLC , where exceptional design meets unparalleled engineering expertise. A DFW and Austin area premier pool builder and outdoor living company. Have Confidence In The Companies You Work With Contact us Custom Swimming Pool Builders DFW & Austin Imagine stepping into your perfect pool, designed exactly to your vision and beyond your expectations. At Hardy Poolscapes , we turn your dream into reality with a level of craftsmanship and service that sets us apart. Picture yourself relaxing in crystal-clear water, enjoying quality time with family and friends, and soaking up the sun in your own private oasis. Our streamlined process ensures that building your pool is stress-free and enjoyable, from start to finish. Let us help you create the backyard escape you’ve always dreamed of—contact us today and experience the Hardy Poolscapes difference. Contact us Reimagine What’s Possible Contact Hardy Poolscapes today and take the first step towards designing your dream pool. Let’s bring your vision to life – your luxury retreat awaits! Contact Us FAQ Does your company offer financing? Yes, we offer several financing options. Please visit our “Partners” tab to explore our preferred lenders and find the best solution for your needs. How long does this process take? Pool construction involves several factors, including weather conditions, local building inspections, and the complexity of your pool design. At Hardy Poolscapes, we work efficiently to minimize our time in your backyard. If everything proceeds as planned, our goal is to have you swimming within 6-10 weeks of excavation. Is my backyard suitable for a swimming pool? During our initial consultation, we’ll evaluate whether your backyard is suitable for a swimming pool, considering factors like size and local regulations. Thanks to our partnership with Noble Excavation, we have the equipment and expertise to work with yards of any size, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. What if I have no idea what goes into the construction of a pool or how the process works? No need to worry! At Hardy Poolscapes, we take pride in delivering exceptional customer service. You’ll be added to a dedicated project group chat, where the entire Hardy team will keep you informed with daily updates on scheduling and timelines, and we’ll be available to answer any questions you may have. Location 17515 Matany Rd #5200, Justin, TX 76247 Contact Info@hardypoolscapes.com DFW: (940) 600-3605 Austin: (512) 977-8199 Hardy Poolscapes LLC

reviews.text:
Great company to work with. Hardy and his team are incredible, their attention to detail is above and beyond. We have many friends with pools who have used other local larger companies and can’t believe how much nice ours is for the same cost.

We had Caden throughout the project and he would update us daily with photos, what was completed and next steps with a timeline.

Highly recommended.
reviews.author: corbin stanley

reviews.text:
We built our first in-ground pool with Hardy Poolscapes and had a fantastic experience from start to finish. From the day they came out to review design options through the final product and even after completion. Their communication was exceptional. We couldn’t be happier with our decision.

We have several friends in Central Texas who’ve had difficult pool-building experiences, so we were nervous going in, but we never had a single bad experience throughout the entire process. We would highly recommend Hardy Poolscapes to anyone considering a pool project.
reviews.author: Luke Seeley

reviews.text: We love our pool. We had an awesome experience with Caden. He was very thorough and communicated throughout the entire process - from start to finish. He went above and beyond to make sure the job was done the way we wanted.
reviews.author: Josh Fort

reviews.text: This was our 5th pool build. This was by far the best experience we have had from start to finish. Caden was here every step of the way and text us every morning to let us know the daily schedule. We would highly recommend Hardy Poolscapes to anyone looking for a new pool.
reviews.author: Linda Holderness

data.summary: The reviews are highly positive and contain authentic, specific details about the customer experience. The low volume of reviews (18 total) and perfect 5.0 Google score with no critical feedback are minor concerns, but the content of the reviews suggests genuine, satisfied customers. The business appears to be a smaller, high-quality operation.
fake_signals: All Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Potential for review solicitation due to perfect scores
authentic_signals: Detailed descriptions of communication and project management
Varied customer perspectives (first-time builders, experienced builders)
Mentions of comparative value with friends' pools
Emotionally authentic language expressing relief and satisfaction
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent and high across Google and Yelp. No BBB profile found is not a red flag for a smaller business.
